stem:
Falguni’s class in Mysuru discusses what the Moon is. They also mention a human-made weather satellite orbiting Earth.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The Moon is a planet that happens to stay near Earth.
Earth is the Moon’s natural satellite.
The Moon is Earth’s natural satellite; a human-made craft orbiting Earth is an artificial satellite, not a natural one.
Earth is a natural satellite of the Sun, so the Moon cannot also be called a satellite.

teacher.key_rationale: The Moon is a natural body orbiting Earth, so it is Earth’s natural satellite. Human-made orbiters are artificial satellites; Earth itself is a planet, not a satellite of the Sun in this classification sense used here.
